timeline.text_en: Kalshi is pitching large banks and hedge funds on a December launch of exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core inflation, with former Barclays trader Michael Ashton hired to design the contracts.

threads.title_zh: Abracadabra 因多次黑客攻击提议清算协议并关闭 MIM
threads.title_en: Abracadabra Proposes Winding Down MIM at Four Cents on the Dollar
threads.summary_zh: Abracadabra 的关停提案已在第二次投票中通过，但该结果依赖降低法定人数门槛并由金库关联地址大量投票，治理争议加剧；MIM 持有者仍面临约每美元四美分的严重减值回收。
threads.summary_en: Abracadabra's wind-down proposal has passed on a second vote, but the result relied on a lowered quorum threshold and heavy voting by a treasury-linked address, deepening governance concerns; MIM holders still face severely impaired recovery of roughly four cents on the dollar.
threads.latest_update_zh: Abracadabra DAO 在第二次“精炼”投票中通过了关停提案：将法定人数门槛从 30 亿 SPELL 降至 3 亿 SPELL，最终由约 3.96 亿 SPELL 赞成推动通过，其中大部分投票来自标注为“Abracadabra.Money: MIM Treasury”的钱包；尽管 Snapshot 显示为“rejected”，按提案中的法定人数调整披露，该投票被视为已通过。
threads.latest_update_en: Abracadabra DAO passed the wind-down proposal on a second 'refined' vote after lowering quorum from 3 billion to 300 million SPELL; about 396 million SPELL voted in favor, largely from the 'Abracadabra.Money: MIM Treasury' wallet, and despite Snapshot displaying 'rejected,' the vote is treated as passed under the proposal's quorum-adjustment disclosure.
threads.background_zh: Abracadabra 于 2021 年上线，是一个以生息代币为抵押铸造 MIM 的借贷协议。2022 年，与 Abracadabra 有关联的 0xSifu 被揭露为长期诈骗者、QuadrigaCX 联合创始人，重创了项目声誉；同年，其与 UST 挂钩的 DegenBox 循环杠杆产品导致约 10 亿美元锁仓价值蒸发。MIM 自 6 月起便处于脱锚状态，当时 DAO 批准将由“Anubis 领导”的团队对资产进行“战略过渡与管理”。该提案仅有两票、合计逾 50 亿枚 SPELL 便获通过，无人反对。7 月初，项目 X 账号曾承诺发布恢复 MIM 锚定、改善协议健康状况的路线图，此后未再发帖。
threads.background_en: Abracadabra launched in 2021 as a lending protocol that mints MIM against interest-bearing tokens. Its reputation was hit in 2022 when Abracadabra-linked 0xSifu was unmasked as a longtime fraudster and co-founder of QuadrigaCX, and the same year its DegenBox looping product tied to UST wiped out roughly $1 billion of its TVL. MIM has been depegged since June, when the DAO approved a “strategic transition and stewardship” of assets to a group “led by Anubis”; that proposal passed with just two votes totalling over 5 billion SPELL and no opposition. In early July the project’s X account promised a roadmap to restore the MIM peg but has not posted since.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Abracadabra DAO passed a controversial proposal to wind down the protocol after reducing quorum requirements, leaving Magic Internet Money holders with a severely impaired recovery and raising governance concerns.
threads.latest_summary_en: Abracadabra DAO passed a controversial proposal to wind down the protocol after reducing quorum requirements, leaving Magic Internet Money holders with a severely impaired recovery and raising governance concerns.
threads.market_impact_zh: 风险敞口集中在仍持有 MIM 的用户以及 MIM 交易的 Curve 资金池上，赎回经济性由约 90 万美元可动用抵押资产决定，而非 2200 万枚未偿付 MIM；SPELL 持有者则需面对 DAO 关停流程。这一事件对抵押型稳定币和 DAO 金库设计构成治理与托管风险信号，但协议规模相较其 60 亿美元峰值已大幅缩水，限制了更广泛传染渠道。
threads.market_impact_en: The exposure is concentrated in remaining MIM holders and the Curve pools where MIM trades, with redemption economics set by the ~$900,000 of actionable backing rather than the 22 million outstanding MIM; SPELL holders face the DAO wind-down process. The episode is a governance- and custody-risk signal for collateralised stablecoin and DAO-treasury designs, though the protocol’s shrunken size relative to its $6 billion peak limits any broader contagion channel.

timeline.text_zh:
Abracadabra 已就“有序关停”协议发起治理投票，理由是一系列安全事件使其稳定币 Magic Internet Money（MIM）已“没有回到锚定价值的可行路径”。提案披露目前有 2200 万枚 MIM 未偿付，而“可动用抵押资产”仅约 90 万美元，隐含每枚 MIM 价值约 0.04 美元；截至发稿，投票约有 1 亿枚 SPELL 赞成、50 万枚反对，投票定于周三晚间结束。

该投票将正式宣告一个锁仓总值曾达 60 亿美元的协议走向终结，其披露的资产缺口意味着仍持有 MIM 的用户将面临重大损失。DeFi 评论人、Trading Strategy 联合创始人 Mikko Ohtamaa 公开将此举称为“金库掠夺”，并指向此前的 DAO 资金转移。

据文章称，该协议因 2024 年 1 月 650 万美元的黑客攻击，以及 2025 年 3 月和 10 月两起分别涉资 1300 万美元和 170 万美元的攻击，累计产生 2100 万美元坏账。Ohtamaa 指出，6 月 8 日和 11 日在 Curve 上出现了金库抛售 MIM 的操作，在“MIM 已经脱锚”的情况下为卖方换回约 50 万美元；随后的一个月又发生“金库提取”，逾 800 万美元被转入一个 Binance 充值地址和一个未标注地址。关停提案既未处理这些资金，也未在赎回计算中将其纳入。
timeline.text_en: Abracadabra has moved to wind down the protocol after repeated hacks left its Magic Internet Money stablecoin with 22 million outstanding MIM against roughly $900,000 in actionable backing, prompting accusations of 'treasury looting' over earlier governance actions.

timeline.text_zh: Snapshot 投票已开启：投票于 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC 开始、2026-09-30 17:24 UTC 结束；已有两地址投票，一地址质押约 1 亿 SPELL 赞成，另一地址质押约 52.3 万 SPELL 反对；提案还称 SPELL 价值清零，MIM 债务优先级高于 SPELL。
timeline.text_en: The Snapshot vote is now open: it began 2026-09-29 05:24 UTC and ends 2026-09-30 17:24 UTC; two addresses have voted, one staking ~100M SPELL in favor and one staking ~523K SPELL against; the proposal also declares SPELL valueless and subordinate to MIM debt.

threads.title_zh: LiteLLM 1.107.0 供应链攻击：恶意版本窃取凭证并植入后门
threads.title_en: Compromised LiteLLM 1.107.0 on PyPI Installs a Credential Stealer and Backdoor
threads.summary_zh: SlowMist 报告称，LiteLLM 再次遭遇供应链攻击：PyPI 上的恶意版本 1.107.0 及其 Docker 镜像会在 Python 启动时自动执行，窃取云凭证、AI API 密钥和 SSH 私钥，并实现远程代码执行；建议用户避免使用 1.107.0，从干净镜像重建，轮换凭证并锁定 1.106.2。
threads.summary_en: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.
threads.latest_update_zh: SlowMist 报告称，LiteLLM 再次遭遇供应链攻击：PyPI 上的恶意版本 1.107.0 及其 Docker 镜像会在 Python 启动时自动执行，窃取云凭证、AI API 密钥和 SSH 私钥，并实现远程代码执行；建议用户避免使用 1.107.0，从干净镜像重建，轮换凭证并锁定 1.106.2。
threads.latest_update_en: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.
threads.background_zh: LiteLLM 是一款开源 AI 网关（LLM 代理），用一套兼容 OpenAI 的 API 统一接入 AI 技术栈，把请求路由到 OpenAI、Anthropic 等模型，并集中管理 API 密钥，支持包括完全离线在内的自托管部署。这是该项目今年第二次遭遇供应链攻击，今年 3 月就曾因另一场供应链攻击遭到投毒。
threads.background_en: LiteLLM is an open-source AI gateway (LLM proxy) that puts an AI stack behind one OpenAI-compatible API, routing requests to models such as OpenAI and Anthropic and centrally managing API keys, with self-hosting including air-gapped deployments. This is the second supply chain attack on the project this year, after an earlier incident in March.
threads.latest_summary_zh: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.
threads.latest_summary_en: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.
threads.discussion_zh: Hacker News 的讨论更多聚焦于问题的系统性而非单一软件包：有人建议使用 canarytokens 来检测凭证是否被盗；有人抱怨权限弹窗疲劳和日常化的软件包安装让开发者对风险变得麻木；还有人质疑一个三年内拥有 5.5 万次提交的项目为何会以这种方式被攻破。一位评论者援引“三名开发者的 GitHub 凭证被窃取”的说法，认为这是系统性问题，并表示会把 LiteLLM 固定在更早的版本直到有进一步消息。
threads.discussion_en: Hacker News commenters focused on the systemic nature of the problem rather than the single package: one suggested using canarytokens to detect credential theft, another complained that permission pop-up fatigue and routine package installation have desensitized developers to risk, and a third questioned how a project with 55,000 commits in three years could be hit this way. One commenter, citing reports that three unique developer GitHub credentials were compromised, called the pattern systemic and said they would pin LiteLLM to a version before this one until further notice.
threads.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是凭证暴露：自托管的 LiteLLM 实例通常在其数据库和主机环境中保存模型 API 密钥、云平台凭证和 SSH 私钥，因此运行此类网关的加密与 AI 智能体团队可能面临部署基础设施凭证外泄的风险，无论是否调用过该库，都需要轮换密钥并重建环境。
threads.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is credential exposure: self-hosted LiteLLM instances commonly hold model API keys, cloud credentials and SSH keys in their databases and host environments, so crypto and AI-agent teams running such gateways may have had deployment infrastructure credentials exposed, requiring key rotation and environment rebuilds regardless of whether they invoked the library.

timeline.text_zh: SlowMist 报告称，LiteLLM 再次遭遇供应链攻击：PyPI 上的恶意版本 1.107.0 及其 Docker 镜像会在 Python 启动时自动执行，窃取云凭证、AI API 密钥和 SSH 私钥，并实现远程代码执行；建议用户避免使用 1.107.0，从干净镜像重建，轮换凭证并锁定 1.106.2。
timeline.text_en: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.

timeline.text_zh: JFrog 披露该供应链攻击还影响官方 Docker 镜像，PyPI 全部七个平台安装包均被植入木马；PyPI 已移除恶意版本，Docker Hub 已撤下受影响镜像；攻击者使用的发布源码指向名称仅差一个连字符的仿冒仓库；建议将凭证视为可能泄露、隔离并重建环境、轮换密钥，回退到 1.106.2。
timeline.text_en: JFrog reported that the supply-chain attack also affected official Docker images and all seven PyPI platform packages; PyPI removed the malicious version and Docker Hub pulled affected images; the release source pointed to a typosquatted repository differing by one hyphen; users are advised to treat credentials as exposed, isolate and rebuild environments, rotate secrets, and roll back to 1.106.2.

timeline.text_zh: PyPI 上被篡改的 LiteLLM 1.107.0 版本携带了凭据窃取器和后门，促使维护者告知用户锁定到 1.106.2 或更早版本，同时向企业客户分发禁运中的修复程序。
timeline.text_en: A tampered LiteLLM 1.107.0 release on PyPI shipped a credential stealer and backdoor, prompting maintainers to tell users to pin to 1.106.2 or earlier while an embargoed fix is distributed to enterprise customers.

threads.title_zh: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
threads.title_en: MiniMax正式发布M3.1 Flash：每百万Token最低0.15美元，23日开源
threads.summary_zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 已完成发布并开源权重：4280亿参数 MoE、Agent 成本降70%、社区许可含收入限制，DeepSWE v1.1 得分73.7%。
threads.summary_en: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is fully released with open weights: 428B-parameter MoE, 70% lower agent-task cost, community license with revenue restrictions, and a 73.7% DeepSWE v1.1 score.

threads.latest_summary_zh: MiniMax released open weights for M3.1 Flash, a 428B-parameter MoE model featuring sparse attention and speculative decoding that cuts agent-task costs by 70% and nearly triples generation speed, under a community license with revenue-based commercial restrictions.
threads.latest_summary_en: MiniMax released open weights for M3.1 Flash, a 428B-parameter MoE model featuring sparse attention and speculative decoding that cuts agent-task costs by 70% and nearly triples generation speed, under a community license with revenue-based commercial restrictions.

timeline.text_en: MiniMax officially released M3.1 Flash, confirming it was the anonymous 'Space Bunny' model, publishing benchmarks (62.2% Automation-Bench, 73.7% DeepSWE, 91.0% BabyVision), setting API pricing at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 output, and planning to open the weights on October 23.

threads.title_zh: Meta Muse 聊天分享链接被曝公开可查，Meta 暂停该功能
threads.title_en: Meta Muse chat-sharing links found publicly discoverable; Meta pauses feature
threads.summary_zh: Meta 已恢复 Muse 的对话分享功能。此前 Claroc 研究人员发现公开可访问的 Muse 聊天链接可暴露敏感材料，Meta 随后暂停了该功能；现在分享功能已重新开启。
threads.summary_en: Meta has restored Muse conversation sharing. The feature had been paused after Claroc researchers showed that publicly accessible Muse chat links could expose sensitive material; sharing is now re-enabled.
threads.latest_update_zh: Meta 已重新启用 Muse 的对话分享功能；此前该功能因公开链接可暴露敏感文档而被暂停。
threads.latest_update_en: Meta re-enabled Muse conversation sharing after the feature had been paused because public links could expose sensitive documents.
threads.background_zh: Meta 推出 Muse 时将其定位为面向普通用户的个人 AI 智能体，并在发布时宣传其安全、可靠且注重隐私。与 AI 助手分享对话是各大聊天机器人产品的常见功能，这也使得链接是否容易被发现成为平台反复面临的隐私问题。
threads.background_en: Meta introduced Muse as a consumer-facing personal AI agent, promoting it at launch as safe, secure and private. Sharing conversations with an AI assistant is a common feature across major chatbot products, which makes link discoverability a recurring privacy concern for platforms.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Meta restored Muse conversation sharing after security researchers showed that publicly accessible links could expose sensitive documents such as internal revenue reviews and loan applications.
threads.latest_summary_en: Meta restored Muse conversation sharing after security researchers showed that publicly accessible links could expose sensitive documents such as internal revenue reviews and loan applications.

timeline.text_zh: Meta 已重新启用 Muse 的对话分享功能；此前该功能因公开链接可暴露敏感文档而被暂停。
timeline.text_en: Meta re-enabled Muse conversation sharing after the feature had been paused because public links could expose sensitive documents.

timeline.text_zh:
Meta 表示已暂停 Muse 的一项分享功能——该功能允许用户分享与这款 AI 助手的对话。此前，安全公司 Claroc 的研究人员通过公开的 DNS 记录发现了超过 6,800 条可公开访问的 Muse 聊天链接，Ars Technica 报道了这一消息。Claroc 本周发布了相关报告。

这次暂停是针对一起隐私暴露事件的产品层面应对，而用户此前可能以为这些对话只在小范围内被分享。

据报道，这些链接是通过公开的 DNS 记录被定位到的，而非由 Meta 主动披露。Meta 称该分享功能为“暂停”，并非永久移除。
timeline.text_en: Meta paused its Muse conversation-sharing feature after Claroc researchers discovered more than 6,800 publicly accessible Muse chat links through public DNS records.

threads.title_zh: Meta未来支出承诺激增至8250亿美元
threads.title_en: Meta未来支出承诺激增至8250亿美元
threads.summary_zh: Meta约8250亿美元未来支出承诺的披露已引发市场重新定价：股价大跌、信用风险指标创历史新高，并波及超大规模云计算与芯片行业的债务风险情绪。
threads.summary_en: The disclosure of Meta's roughly $825 billion in committed future spending has triggered a market repricing: shares sold off, credit risk indicators hit record highs, and debt-risk sentiment spread across hyperscale cloud and chip companies.
threads.latest_update_zh: Meta披露约8250亿美元未来支出承诺后，股价从盘后上涨转为收跌约7%，五年期CDS升至历史最高，债券相对美债走弱，并引发超大规模云与芯片公司信用风险担忧蔓延。

threads.title_zh: Robinhood 股票代币交易量达150亿美元，Morpho 支持其作为稳定币贷款抵押品
threads.title_en: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days
threads.summary_zh: Morpho已推出支持将Robinhood股票代币作为稳定币贷款抵押品，Robinhood Chain提供代币化基础设施，第三方应用可接入这些借贷市场。
threads.summary_en: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.
threads.latest_update_zh:
10 月 22 日，借贷协议 Morpho 宣布 Robinhood 股票代币已在其平台上线，用户可将股票代币作为抵押品借入稳定币。Morpho 提供底层信贷网络，Robinhood Crypto 旗下的 Robinhood Chain 提供代币化基础设施，任何应用均可接入面向股票代币的借贷市场。

该集成把链上信贷市场的抵押品范围扩展到代币化股票，超出了 DeFi 借贷通常接受的加密原生资产范畴。

Morpho 在其中的角色是信贷层而非代币化层，股票代币的发行与结算由 Robinhood Chain 承担。公告未披露具体支持哪些股票、抵押率，以及已有哪些应用完成接入。
threads.latest_update_en: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.
threads.background_zh: Morpho 是 2021 年推出的开源 DeFi 借贷网络，运行于以太坊及其他 EVM 兼容链上，允许开发者基于其基础设施构建定制化借贷市场。Robinhood Chain 是 Robinhood 基于 Arbitrum 技术构建的以太坊 Layer 2，面向代币化现实世界资产，初期聚焦美国股票与 ETF 敞口，通过追踪股价、可全天候交易的 ERC-20 股票代币实现。
threads.background_en: Morpho is an open-source DeFi lending network launched in 2021 that runs on Ethereum and other EVM-compatible chains, letting developers build customized lending markets on its infrastructure. Robinhood Chain is Robinhood's Arbitrum-based Ethereum Layer 2 aimed at tokenized real-world assets, with an initial focus on US equity and ETF exposure through ERC-20 stock tokens that track share prices and trade around the clock.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.
threads.latest_summary_en: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这一举措把 DeFi 信贷流动性与股票市场定价连接起来：Morpho 市场上的稳定币借款需求部分取决于代币化股票抵押品，而股票代币的全天候交易与价格源将成为这些市场清算与风险管理的输入。风险敞口主要集中在 Morpho 的借贷池、稳定币借款方以及 Robinhood Chain 生态。
threads.market_impact_en: The move links DeFi credit liquidity to equity-market pricing: demand for stablecoin borrowing inside Morpho markets now depends partly on tokenized-stock collateral, while the stock tokens' 24/7 trading and price feeds become inputs to liquidation and risk management for those markets. Exposure concentrates in Morpho's lending pools, stablecoin borrowers, and the Robinhood Chain ecosystem.

timeline.text_zh:
10 月 22 日，借贷协议 Morpho 宣布 Robinhood 股票代币已在其平台上线，用户可将股票代币作为抵押品借入稳定币。Morpho 提供底层信贷网络，Robinhood Crypto 旗下的 Robinhood Chain 提供代币化基础设施，任何应用均可接入面向股票代币的借贷市场。

该集成把链上信贷市场的抵押品范围扩展到代币化股票，超出了 DeFi 借贷通常接受的加密原生资产范畴。

Morpho 在其中的角色是信贷层而非代币化层，股票代币的发行与结算由 Robinhood Chain 承担。公告未披露具体支持哪些股票、抵押率，以及已有哪些应用完成接入。
timeline.text_en: Morpho has launched support for Robinhood stock tokens as collateral for stablecoin loans, with Robinhood Chain supplying the tokenization infrastructure and third-party apps able to integrate the lending markets.

timeline.text_zh:
Robinhood 表示，其股票代币（Stock Tokens）累计交易额已突破 150 亿美元，持有者数量达到 20 万，同时其公链运行已满 100 天。Morpho 的仪表盘显示，该网络上的存款规模约为 11 亿美元。

这是目前代币化股票领域披露的规模最大的量化里程碑之一，而 Morpho 的存款数据表明 Robinhood 链上已经承载了第三方 DeFi 借贷活动。

Robinhood 的股票代币是由 Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited 发行的代币化债务证券，仅提供对标的证券的经济敞口，不赋予投资者对标的发行公司的法定权利或受益权；目前可交易品种超过 190 个，涵盖与 NVIDIA、Google、Apple 和 Invesco QQQ 挂钩的代币。约 11 亿美元的存款数据来自 Morpho 自身的仪表盘，而非 Robinhood 公布。
timeline.text_en: Robinhood says its stock tokens have crossed $15 billion in cumulative trading volume with 200,000 holders as its chain passes 100 days, while Morpho's dashboard shows about $1.1 billion deposited on the network.

threads.title_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉成立特别委员会探讨潜在合并
threads.title_en: SpaceX and Tesla form special committees to explore potential merger
threads.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示，SpaceX和特斯拉已成立独立的董事会委员会，探讨一项可能缔造约3.5万亿美元公司的合并，业务涵盖火箭、电动汽车、人形机器人、社交媒体和Grok AI聊天机器人。
threads.summary_en: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed independent board committees to explore a merger that could create a roughly $3.5 trillion company spanning rockets, electric vehicles, humanoid robots, social media, and the Grok AI chatbot.
threads.latest_update_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉已成立特别委员会，探讨由马斯克支持的潜在合并，推动SPCX永续合约成交量上涨近130%至31.5亿美元，清算金额426万美元，未平仓合约105亿美元。
threads.latest_update_en: SpaceX and Tesla have set up a special committee to explore a potential merger backed by Musk, sending SPCX perpetual futures volume up nearly 130% to $3.15B with $4.26M in liquidations and $10.5B open interest.
threads.latest_summary_zh: SpaceX and Tesla have set up a special committee to explore a potential merger backed by Musk, sending SPCX perpetual futures volume up nearly 130% to $3.15B with $4.26M in liquidations and $10.5B open interest.
threads.latest_summary_en: SpaceX and Tesla have set up a special committee to explore a potential merger backed by Musk, sending SPCX perpetual futures volume up nearly 130% to $3.15B with $4.26M in liquidations and $10.5B open interest.

timeline.text_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉已成立特别委员会，探讨由马斯克支持的潜在合并，推动SPCX永续合约成交量上涨近130%至31.5亿美元，清算金额426万美元，未平仓合约105亿美元。
timeline.text_en: SpaceX and Tesla have set up a special committee to explore a potential merger backed by Musk, sending SPCX perpetual futures volume up nearly 130% to $3.15B with $4.26M in liquidations and $10.5B open interest.

timeline.text_zh: 马斯克公开表示SpaceX与特斯拉合并是“好主意”，并称双方特别委员会应股东要求讨论该想法；但他强调委员会尚未就交易条款达成一致，也不能保证会达成，且特斯拉侧需全部股份的50%支持。
timeline.text_en: Musk publicly said a SpaceX-Tesla merger is a 'good idea' and that special committees are discussing it at shareholder request, while stressing no terms have been agreed, no deal is guaranteed, and Tesla would need 50% of all shares to approve.

timeline.text_zh: SpaceX与特斯拉各自成立了独立董事特别委员会，探讨潜在合并事宜，埃隆·马斯克已回避，并指出任何交易都需获得50%特斯拉股东的批准。
timeline.text_en: SpaceX and Tesla have each formed independent-director special committees to explore a potential merger, with Elon Musk recusing himself and noting that any deal would need approval from 50% of Tesla shareholders.

threads.title_zh: 微软发布AI医疗诊断工具，称其诊断准确率优于医生
threads.title_en: Microsoft unveils AI diagnostic tool claimed to outperform doctors
threads.summary_zh: 一项《科学》研究发现，微软的新AI诊断系统在疑难病例上胜过全科医生，不过大部分提升被归因于底层AI模型，而非微软系统本身。
threads.summary_en: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.
threads.latest_update_zh: 一项《科学》研究发现，微软的新AI诊断系统在疑难病例上胜过全科医生，不过大部分提升被归因于底层AI模型，而非微软系统本身。
threads.latest_update_en: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.
threads.background_zh: AI公司长期将医疗健康视为其技术的旗舰应用场景，苏莱曼也公开将这项工作描述为迈向其所称“医疗超级智能”的努力。此前的研究普遍发现，生成式AI的诊断表现与非专家级医生相当，但低于专家级的可靠性水平。
threads.background_en: AI companies have long pitched healthcare as a flagship use case for their technology, and Suleyman has publicly framed the work as a push toward what he calls medical superintelligence. Earlier research has generally found generative AI diagnostic performance comparable to non-expert physicians but below expert-level reliability.
threads.latest_summary_zh: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.
threads.latest_summary_en: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此事对加密市场没有直接的传导路径：该发布涉及的是一套临床诊断系统，不包含代币、托管或链上组件。若有影响也只可能是间接的，通过AI板块的整体情绪传导，而AI概念代币有时会跟随这一情绪。
threads.market_impact_en: There is no direct transmission path to crypto markets: the announcement concerns a clinical diagnostic system with no token, custody, or on-chain component. Any effect would be indirect, via general AI-sector sentiment that AI-branded tokens sometimes track.

timeline.text_zh: 一项《科学》研究发现，微软的新AI诊断系统在疑难病例上胜过全科医生，不过大部分提升被归因于底层AI模型，而非微软系统本身。
timeline.text_en: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.

timeline.text_zh:
微软AI部门首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼宣布推出一款新的AI诊断系统，公司称其在诊断疾病方面比人类医生的准确率最高可达四倍。该说法基于2026年10月22日发表在《Science》上的同行评审研究。

该结果发表在同行评审期刊而非公司演示中，使微软的说法比一般产品发布更具分量。不过，对照对象是在疑难病例上的一般内科医生，而非专科医生。

微软该系统被称为“诊断编排器”（MAI-DxO），在《Science》研究中报告的准确率为83.2%。相关报道指出，性能提升的很大一部分似乎来自底层AI模型，而非微软的系统本身。
timeline.text_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.

threads.title_zh: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】
threads.title_en: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】
threads.summary_zh: Uniswap v4 Aggregator Hooks 已上线，覆盖以太坊主网、Base 与 Robinhood Chain，首日支持 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap 等七个外部来源；经其路由的兑换将收取协议费并贡献于 UNI 销毁。
threads.summary_en: Uniswap v4 Aggregator Hooks are live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain, initially supporting seven external sources including Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap; swaps routed through them incur protocol fees contributing to UNI burns.
threads.latest_update_zh: 上线首日支持七个外部来源（包括 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap）；经外部来源路由的兑换将收取协议费并贡献于 UNI 销毁；每区块拉取最新报价并在单笔交易内完成结算，无需新增授权。
threads.latest_update_en: Adds that the launch supports seven external sources on day one, including Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap; swaps routed through external sources incur protocol fees contributing to UNI burns; quotes refresh each block and settle in a single transaction without new approvals.
threads.background_zh: Uniswap v4 于 2025 年 1 月上线主网，引入 Hook、单例合约设计与闪 accounting（闪电记账）机制。Hook 允许开发者给资金池附加自定义逻辑，而 Aggregator Hooks 是首次用该机制将路由接入其他协议的流动性，而不仅是 Uniswap 自身资金池。
threads.background_en: Uniswap v4 launched on mainnet in January 2025, introducing hooks, the singleton contract design and flash accounting. Hooks let developers attach custom logic to pools, and Aggregator Hooks is the first use of that mechanism to route into other protocols' liquidity rather than only Uniswap's own pools.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Uniswap launched v4 Aggregator Hooks, letting external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap be wrapped as v4 pools and routed through Uniswap on Ethereum, Base, and Robinhood Chain, with swap fees contributing to UNI burns.
threads.latest_summary_en: Uniswap launched v4 Aggregator Hooks, letting external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap be wrapped as v4 pools and routed through Uniswap on Ethereum, Base, and Robinhood Chain, with swap fees contributing to UNI burns.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次发布直接作用于 DEX 聚合器这一细分市场：Uniswap v4 现在可以通过自身路由吸收 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap 等场所的报价，聚合器订单流与手续费捕获由此向 Uniswap 网页端与 API 转移。对 UNI 而言，传导渠道是经外部来源路由的兑换所缴纳的协议费进入销毁，使代币供应不仅取决于 Uniswap 原生池活动，也对聚合交易量敏感。
threads.market_impact_en: The release touches the DEX aggregator segment directly: Uniswap v4 can now absorb quotes from venues such as Curve, Fluid and PancakeSwap through its own router, so aggregator order flow and fee capture shift toward Uniswap's Web app and API. For UNI, the transmission channel is the protocol fee on externally routed swaps feeding the burn, making token supply sensitive to aggregator volume rather than only to Uniswap-native pool activity.

timeline.text_en: Adds that the launch supports seven external sources on day one, including Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap; swaps routed through external sources incur protocol fees contributing to UNI burns; quotes refresh each block and settle in a single transaction without new approvals.

timeline.text_zh: Uniswap 推出 Aggregator Hooks，使 v4 能将 Curve、Fluid 和 PancakeSwap 等外部流动性来源接入 v4 流动性池，已通过 Uniswap Web 应用和 API 在以太坊主网、Base 和 Robinhood Chain 上线。
timeline.text_en: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.

threads.title_zh: Meta 董事会批准无投票权 C 类股票以资助 AI 建设并保留扎克伯格控制权
threads.title_en: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
threads.summary_zh: Meta董事会批准了一项无投票权的C类股票，自2027年1月19日起按一比一比例向现有股东分配，实际上相当于二比一拆股，使公司能够出售股权，为耗资数千亿美元的AI建设提供资金，同时保留马克·扎克伯格的投票控制权。

timeline.text_en: Meta will issue a new non-voting class of shares, trading from 2027, to fund its AI buildout, potential acquisitions and employee compensation, as disclosed in its Q3 2026 earnings report.

threads.title_zh: Coldcard 固件随机数漏洞致用户损失并引发加拿大集体诉讼
threads.title_en: Coldcard Loses $70M In 41 Minutes As CZ Warns Hardware Wallets Can Fail
threads.summary_zh: Coinkite 及其联合创始人在加拿大安大略省面临一项拟议的集体诉讼，指控 Coldcard 的标准固件使用可预测的伪随机数生成器，使种子短语可被复现，导致用户的比特币面临风险，诉讼依据消费者保护和货物销售法提出，并包含过失和违约索赔。
threads.summary_en: Coinkite and its co-founders face a proposed class action in Ontario, Canada, alleging Coldcard's standard firmware used a predictable pseudo-random number generator that made seed phrases reproducible and left users' bitcoin vulnerable, with claims under consumer protection and sale-of-goods law plus negligence and breach of contract.
threads.latest_update_zh: Coinkite 及其联合创始人在加拿大安大略省面临一项拟议的集体诉讼，指控 Coldcard 的标准固件使用可预测的伪随机数生成器，使种子短语可被复现，导致用户的比特币面临风险，诉讼依据消费者保护和货物销售法提出，并包含过失和违约索赔。

timeline.text_en: Coldcard hardware-wallet users reportedly lost about $70M in 41 minutes during a security incident, prompting Binance's CZ to warn that hardware wallets can fail.

threads.title_zh: Railway曝安全事件：部分密钥明文恐遭窃取，攻击疑似瞄准AI服务商
threads.title_en: Railway曝安全事件：部分密钥明文恐遭窃取，攻击疑似瞄准AI服务商
threads.summary_zh: Railway 在披露环境变量存储遭未授权访问后，进一步向使用谷歌云服务账号密钥的用户发布密钥轮换、凭据更换、重新部署及云审计排查指引；该事件仍被报道为可能与 Swell DAO 管理员密钥疑似泄露相关。
threads.summary_en: After disclosing unauthorized access to its environment-variable storage, Railway issued guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to rotate credentials, redeploy, and audit cloud activity; the incident remains reported as possibly linked to the suspected Swell DAO admin-key compromise.
threads.latest_update_zh: Railway 发布后续安全指引，要求使用谷歌云服务账号密钥的用户禁用并轮换可能泄露的密钥、重新部署服务，并检查云审计日志与账单；报道还称该事件可能与 Swell DAO 的 swETH/rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露相关。
threads.latest_update_en: Railway issued follow-up guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to disable and rotate potentially leaked keys, redeploy services, and audit cloud logs and billing; the report also links the incident to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO swETH/rswETH admin keys.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Railway issued security guidance telling users to disable and rotate potentially leaked Google Cloud service-account keys and audit for unauthorized activity, following its October 21 incident that is linked to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO's swETH/rswETH admin keys and malicious upgrade contracts that could drain ~2,500 ETH.
threads.latest_summary_en: Railway issued security guidance telling users to disable and rotate potentially leaked Google Cloud service-account keys and audit for unauthorized activity, following its October 21 incident that is linked to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO's swETH/rswETH admin keys and malicious upgrade contracts that could drain ~2,500 ETH.

timeline.text_zh: Railway 发布后续安全指引，要求使用谷歌云服务账号密钥的用户禁用并轮换可能泄露的密钥、重新部署服务，并检查云审计日志与账单；报道还称该事件可能与 Swell DAO 的 swETH/rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露相关。
timeline.text_en: Railway issued follow-up guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to disable and rotate potentially leaked keys, redeploy services, and audit cloud logs and billing; the report also links the incident to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO swETH/rswETH admin keys.

timeline.text_zh: Railway 披露其环境变量存储中存在未经授权的活动，可能暴露了加密的以及可能明文的客户机密，促使所有用户轮换密钥，并暂时停止全平台的构建和部署。
timeline.text_en: Railway disclosed unauthorized activity in its environment-variable storage that may have exposed encrypted and possibly plaintext customer secrets, prompting all users to rotate keys and temporarily halting platform-wide builds and deployments.

threads.title_zh: ⚡️SoFi推出计息代币化存款SoFi Earn
threads.title_en: ⚡️SoFi推出计息代币化存款SoFi Earn
threads.summary_zh: SoFi 已宣布计息代币化存款 SoFi Earn（SOFIE），年化 4.4%，在适用限额内受 FDIC 保险，预计 11 月向加密会员全面上线；SOFIE 可 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD，SoFiUSD 本身不属于 FDIC 保险存款。
threads.summary_en: SoFi has announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit at 4.4% APY, FDIC-insured within applicable limits, with full rollout to crypto members expected in November; SOFIE is convertible 1:1 into SoFiUSD, which itself is not an FDIC-insured deposit.
threads.latest_update_zh: 报道澄清 SoFi Earn 是已宣布、预计 11 月全面上线，而非已完成全面推出；并补充 SOFIE 可按 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD、用于购买加密货币或转至外部钱包，且 SoFiUSD 本身不受 FDIC 保险。
threads.latest_update_en: The report clarifies that SoFi Earn was announced with full rollout expected in November, rather than fully launched; it adds that SOFIE can be converted 1:1 into SoFiUSD for crypto purchases or external wallet transfers, and that SoFiUSD itself is not FDIC-insured.
threads.latest_summary_zh: SoFi announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit paying 4.4% APY and FDIC-insured within applicable limits, which members can convert 1:1 into the SoFiUSD stablecoin via SoFi Crypto to buy crypto or transfer to external wallets, with full rollout expected in November.
threads.latest_summary_en: SoFi announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit paying 4.4% APY and FDIC-insured within applicable limits, which members can convert 1:1 into the SoFiUSD stablecoin via SoFi Crypto to buy crypto or transfer to external wallets, with full rollout expected in November.

timeline.text_zh: 报道澄清 SoFi Earn 是已宣布、预计 11 月全面上线，而非已完成全面推出；并补充 SOFIE 可按 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD、用于购买加密货币或转至外部钱包，且 SoFiUSD 本身不受 FDIC 保险。
timeline.text_en: The report clarifies that SoFi Earn was announced with full rollout expected in November, rather than fully launched; it adds that SOFIE can be converted 1:1 into SoFiUSD for crypto purchases or external wallet transfers, and that SoFiUSD itself is not FDIC-insured.

timeline.text_zh: SoFi 推出 SoFi Earn（SOFIE），这是一种计息代币化存款，年化收益率 4.4%，在适用限额内享有 FDIC 保险，可按 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD 稳定币，成为美国国民银行首个直接面向零售的代币化存款产品。
timeline.text_en: SoFi launched SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit paying 4.4% APY and FDIC-insured within applicable limits, convertible 1:1 into the SoFiUSD stablecoin, marking the first direct retail tokenized-deposit offering by a US national bank.

threads.title_zh: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
threads.title_en: 【Spreek：Swell DAO 的 swETH 与 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，分析报告由 Claude 辅助撰写】
threads.summary_zh: Swell 正在调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，暂无 ETH 从相关存款或提款合约流出；此前 Spreek 报告的疑似管理员密钥泄露和四个恶意升级合约仍处于调查中。
threads.summary_en: Swell is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity and says no ETH has flowed out of the relevant deposit or withdrawal contracts; the suspected admin-key leak and four malicious upgrade contracts reported by Spreek remain under investigation.
threads.latest_update_zh: Swell 官方表示正与安全合作伙伴调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，并采取预防措施；同时称目前暂无 ETH 从存款或提款合约流出，用户无需采取行动。
threads.latest_update_en: Swell officially said it is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity with security partners and taking precautionary measures; it stated that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts and users need not take action.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Swell is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity amid reports of a possible admin-key compromise and malicious upgrade contracts, while stating that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts.
threads.latest_summary_en: Swell is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity amid reports of a possible admin-key compromise and malicious upgrade contracts, while stating that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts.

timeline.text_zh: Swell 官方表示正与安全合作伙伴调查 swETH 与 rswETH 合约可疑活动，并采取预防措施；同时称目前暂无 ETH 从存款或提款合约流出，用户无需采取行动。
timeline.text_en: Swell officially said it is investigating suspicious swETH and rswETH contract activity with security partners and taking precautionary measures; it stated that no ETH has flowed out of the deposit or withdrawal contracts and users need not take action.

timeline.text_zh: 链上分析师 Spreek 报告称，Swell DAO 的 swETH 和 rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露，攻击者每小时将净值抬高最多 1%，并部署了四个恶意升级合约，可能危及约 2500 ETH。
timeline.text_en: Chain analyst Spreek reports a suspected leak of Swell DAO's swETH and rswETH admin keys, with attackers inflating NAV by up to 1% per hour and deploying four malicious upgrade contracts that could endanger roughly 2,500 ETH.

threads.title_zh: 英高院裁定「钱志敏案」逾6.1万枚比特币相关权属主张适用中国法，涉案资金约41亿英镑
threads.title_en: 英高院裁定「钱志敏案」逾6.1万枚比特币相关权属主张适用中国法，涉案资金约41亿英镑
threads.summary_zh: 英国高等法院此前裁定，钱志敏案中逾6.1万枚被扣押比特币的中国投资者财产权主张应依据中国法而非英国法判断；现在法院已批准约1.6万名中国受害者就该裁决提出上诉，裁决仍有效但进入上诉挑战阶段。
threads.summary_en: The UK High Court had ruled that Chinese investors' property-rights claims over more than 61,000 seized bitcoins in the Qian Zhimin case must be decided under Chinese law rather than English law; the court has now granted approximately 16,000 Chinese victims permission to appeal that ruling, so the ruling stands but is subject to appeal.
threads.latest_update_zh: 英国高等法院已批准约1.6万名钱志敏案中国受害者就10月12日关于逾6万枚比特币财产权争议适用中国法的裁决提出上诉。
threads.latest_update_en: The UK High Court granted permission for approximately 16,000 Chinese victims in the Qian Zhimin case to appeal the 12 October ruling that Chinese law applies to the property-rights dispute over more than 60,000 bitcoins.
threads.latest_summary_zh: The UK High Court has allowed about 16,000 Chinese victims in the Qian Zhimin case to appeal a ruling on the property rights to over 60,000 bitcoin.
threads.latest_summary_en: The UK High Court has allowed about 16,000 Chinese victims in the Qian Zhimin case to appeal a ruling on the property rights to over 60,000 bitcoin.

timeline.text_zh: 英国高等法院已批准约1.6万名钱志敏案中国受害者就10月12日关于逾6万枚比特币财产权争议适用中国法的裁决提出上诉。
timeline.text_en: The UK High Court granted permission for approximately 16,000 Chinese victims in the Qian Zhimin case to appeal the 12 October ruling that Chinese law applies to the property-rights dispute over more than 60,000 bitcoins.

timeline.text_zh: 该裁决的实际后果明确：约1.6万名参与英国追索程序的中国受害者可能只能拿回本金及利息，而无法分享涉案比特币价格暴涨带来的增值收益。
timeline.text_en: The ruling's practical consequence was clarified: approximately 16,000 Chinese victims participating in UK recovery proceedings may recover only principal plus interest, and cannot share in the massive price appreciation of the seized bitcoin.

timeline.text_zh: 英国高等法院裁定，中国投资者对蓝天格锐欺诈案中在英国被扣押的逾6.1万枚比特币的财产权主张，必须依据中国法律而非英国法律来裁定，此案涉及与约41亿英镑（约合人民币402亿元）计划相关的资产。
timeline.text_en: The UK High Court ruled that Chinese investors' property-rights claims over more than 61,000 bitcoins seized in the UK in the Blue Sky Gerui fraud case must be determined under Chinese law rather than English law, affecting assets linked to a ~£4.1bn (~RMB 40.2bn) scheme.

threads.title_zh: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%
threads.title_en: Pirate Chain确认近日遭攻击，代币供应量增发约20%
threads.summary_zh: Pirate Chain 已进入修复阶段：强制升级 v6.0.14 已发布，相关验证漏洞已修复，链已回滚至区块 4,176,944 以清除伪造 ARRR 并恢复供应上限；旧版本运营方被要求立即升级。
threads.summary_en: Pirate Chain is in remediation: mandatory v6.0.14 has been released, the validation vulnerabilities are fixed, and the chain has been rolled back to block 4,176,944 to purge forged ARRR and restore the supply cap; old-version operators are required to upgrade immediately.
threads.latest_update_zh: Pirate Chain 发布强制升级 v6.0.14，并要求旧版本用户、节点、矿工、矿池、交易所及服务商升级；社区通过共识将链回滚至区块 4,176,944，以移除约 3982 万枚伪造 ARRR 并恢复 2 亿枚供应上限。
threads.latest_update_en: Pirate Chain released mandatory v6.0.14, requiring old-version users, nodes, miners, pools, exchanges and service providers to upgrade; by community consensus the chain was rolled back to block 4,176,944 to remove about 39.82 million forged ARRR and restore the 200 million supply cap.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Pirate Chain issued a mandatory v6.0.14 upgrade and rolled the chain back to block 4,176,944 to purge ~39.82 million forged ARRR created through two validation vulnerabilities on October 14, restoring the 200 million supply cap.
threads.latest_summary_en: Pirate Chain issued a mandatory v6.0.14 upgrade and rolled the chain back to block 4,176,944 to purge ~39.82 million forged ARRR created through two validation vulnerabilities on October 14, restoring the 200 million supply cap.

timeline.text_zh: Pirate Chain 发布强制升级 v6.0.14，并要求旧版本用户、节点、矿工、矿池、交易所及服务商升级；社区通过共识将链回滚至区块 4,176,944，以移除约 3982 万枚伪造 ARRR 并恢复 2 亿枚供应上限。
timeline.text_en: Pirate Chain released mandatory v6.0.14, requiring old-version users, nodes, miners, pools, exchanges and service providers to upgrade; by community consensus the chain was rolled back to block 4,176,944 to remove about 39.82 million forged ARRR and restore the 200 million supply cap.

timeline.text_zh: Pirate Chain 确认了一个交易验证漏洞，该漏洞产生了约 3980 万枚未经授权的 ARRR（约占供应量的 20%），促使 dPoW 运营者暂停公证，团队则要求交易所和矿池暂停运营，同时制定恢复计划。
timeline.text_en: Pirate Chain confirmed a transaction-validation vulnerability that created roughly 39.8 million unauthorized ARRR (about 20% of supply), prompting dPoW operators to pause notarization and the team to ask exchanges and mining pools to suspend operations while a recovery plan is drawn up.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Duet AI助手
threads.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI assistant
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出研究预览版 Claude Duet，这是一款基于 Claude Opus 5.5 构建的主动式智能体助手，运行在自带浏览器的云虚拟机中，可提供每日简报、通过 6000 多个连接器执行多步骤业务任务，敏感操作需用户明确批准，同时禁止证券交易和账户转账等操作。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, a proactive agentic assistant built on Claude Opus 5.5 that runs in a cloud VM with its own browser, delivers daily briefings, executes multi-step business tasks across 6,000+ connectors, and requires explicit user approval for sensitive actions while prohibiting others such as securities trading and account transfers.
threads.latest_update_zh: Anthropic 推出研究预览版 Claude Duet，这是一款基于 Claude Opus 5.5 构建的主动式智能体助手，运行在自带浏览器的云虚拟机中，可提供每日简报、通过 6000 多个连接器执行多步骤业务任务，敏感操作需用户明确批准，同时禁止证券交易和账户转账等操作。
threads.latest_update_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, a proactive agentic assistant built on Claude Opus 5.5 that runs in a cloud VM with its own browser, delivers daily briefings, executes multi-step business tasks across 6,000+ connectors, and requires explicit user approval for sensitive actions while prohibiting others such as securities trading and account transfers.
threads.background_zh: Claude Duet进入的是一个已相当拥挤的智能体市场：Meta推出Muse，将其定位为运行在专用“Muse Secure VM”上的个人AI智能体；OpenAI则在2026年9月29日的DevDay 2026主题演讲上发布了“始终在线”的Dots智能体。此前Anthropic的Claude产品主要通过对话界面使用，而非主动式的独立智能体应用。
threads.background_en: Claude Duet enters a crowded agent market: Meta introduced Muse as a personal AI agent running on a dedicated "Muse Secure VM," and OpenAI launched Dots as always-on agents at its DevDay 2026 keynote on September 29, 2026. Anthropic's previous Claude offerings were primarily accessed through chat interfaces rather than a proactive, standalone agent app.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, a proactive agentic assistant built on Claude Opus 5.5 that runs in a cloud VM with its own browser, delivers daily briefings, executes multi-step business tasks across 6,000+ connectors, and requires explicit user approval for sensitive actions while prohibiting others such as securities trading and account transfers.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, a proactive agentic assistant built on Claude Opus 5.5 that runs in a cloud VM with its own browser, delivers daily briefings, executes multi-step business tasks across 6,000+ connectors, and requires explicit user approval for sensitive actions while prohibiting others such as securities trading and account transfers.
threads.market_impact_zh: 此次发布强化了三大实验室围绕“始终在线”AI智能体的竞争叙事，这一主题通常影响的是与AI相关的加密板块情绪，而非某一代币的基本面。传导路径主要是叙事与资金关注度流向智能体概念代币及AI算力、推理相关资产，而非直接的协议层面敞口。
threads.market_impact_en: The release feeds the competitive narrative around always-on AI agents from the three largest labs, a theme that typically moves sentiment in AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than any single token's fundamentals. Any transmission would run through narrative and attention flows toward agent-branded tokens and AI compute/inference-related assets, not through direct protocol exposure.

threads.title_zh: PancakeSwap核心团队在治理论坛提出"The Flip"提案：LP分成升至88%，CAKE排放削减约69%
threads.title_en: PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emission
threads.summary_zh: “The Flip”提案已从治理论坛提议阶段进入治理投票阶段，投票截至 2026 年 10 月 24 日；若通过，预计 11 月起实施。PancakeSwap TVL 同期升至约 24 亿美元。
threads.summary_en: 'The Flip' has moved from a governance-forum proposal to an active governance vote running until Oct. 24, 2026; if approved, implementation is expected from November. PancakeSwap TVL rose to about $2.4 billion over the same period.
threads.latest_update_zh: PancakeSwap 已于 2026 年 10 月 21 日就“The Flip”提案开启治理投票，投票持续至 10 月 24 日；若获批，预计 11 月开始实施。同期 PancakeSwap TVL 上升约 19% 至约 24 亿美元，V3 池 TVL 从约 3.36 亿美元增至约 7.39 亿美元。
threads.latest_update_en: PancakeSwap opened a governance vote on 'The Flip' on Oct. 21, 2026, running through Oct. 24, with implementation expected to begin in November if approved. Over the same period, PancakeSwap TVL rose about 19% to roughly $2.4 billion, with V3 pool TVL increasing from about $336 million to about $739 million.
threads.latest_summary_zh: PancakeSwap's TVL rose ~19% to $2.4B as the protocol opened a governance vote on 'The Flip', which would lift liquidity providers' share of swap fees to 88% and cut CAKE emissions by 69%.
threads.latest_summary_en: PancakeSwap's TVL rose ~19% to $2.4B as the protocol opened a governance vote on 'The Flip', which would lift liquidity providers' share of swap fees to 88% and cut CAKE emissions by 69%.

timeline.text_zh: PancakeSwap 已于 2026 年 10 月 21 日就“The Flip”提案开启治理投票，投票持续至 10 月 24 日；若获批，预计 11 月开始实施。同期 PancakeSwap TVL 上升约 19% 至约 24 亿美元，V3 池 TVL 从约 3.36 亿美元增至约 7.39 亿美元。
timeline.text_en: PancakeSwap opened a governance vote on 'The Flip' on Oct. 21, 2026, running through Oct. 24, with implementation expected to begin in November if approved. Over the same period, PancakeSwap TVL rose about 19% to roughly $2.4 billion, with V3 pool TVL increasing from about $336 million to about $739 million.

timeline.text_zh: 提案细节进一步明确：协议费降至12%并归入国库，v2保持不变；每日7000枚CAKE排放全部划入新设立的生态增长基金Pantry，用于营销、合作及新池子引导；基于2025年交易量测算LP将多获得约6200万美元手续费；CAKE通缩仍按Tokenomics 3.0推进。
timeline.text_en: Proposal details further specified: protocol fee reduced to 12% and directed to treasury, v2 unchanged; all 7,000 daily CAKE emissions to new Pantry ecosystem growth fund for marketing, partnerships, and new pool bootstrapping; LPs estimated to gain ~$62M more in fees based on 2025 volume; CAKE deflation remains on Tokenomics 3.0 track.

timeline.text_zh: PancakeSwap 的 Kitchen 提议将全部 11 条链上 v3 和 Infinity swap 费用的 LP 分成提高至 88%，并将每日 CAKE 排放量从 22,500 枚削减约 69% 至 7,000 枚，该提案有待 Snapshot 投票，实施目标为 2026 年 11 月至 2027 年 1 月。
timeline.text_en: PancakeSwap's Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of v3 and Infinity swap fees to 88% across all 11 chains and cutting daily CAKE emissions roughly 69% from 22,500 to 7,000, pending a Snapshot vote with implementation targeted for November 2026 through January 2027.

threads.title_zh: Anthropic CEO呼吁AI研发减速至更安全节奏
threads.title_en: Anthropic CEO urges slowdown of AI development to a safer pace
threads.summary_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 公开为公司安全记录和“向上竞争”策略辩护，同时承认 AI 可能很快加速下一代 AI 开发，以至于需要对研究速度施加直接限制；此前批评者质疑了 Anthropic 的 AI 安全法案草案及其放宽的内部安全承诺。
threads.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly defended the company's safety record and 'race to the top' strategy while acknowledging that AI may soon accelerate next-generation AI development enough to require direct limits on research speed, after critics questioned Anthropic's draft AI safety bill and relaxed internal safety commitments.
threads.latest_update_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 公开为公司安全记录和“向上竞争”策略辩护，同时承认 AI 可能很快加速下一代 AI 开发，以至于需要对研究速度施加直接限制；此前批评者质疑了 Anthropic 的 AI 安全法案草案及其放宽的内部安全承诺。
threads.latest_update_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly defended the company's safety record and 'race to the top' strategy while acknowledging that AI may soon accelerate next-generation AI development enough to require direct limits on research speed, after critics questioned Anthropic's draft AI safety bill and relaxed internal safety commitments.
threads.background_zh: METR 评估前沿 AI 模型的能力，一些研究者认为这类能力可能给社会带来灾难性风险。Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 曾公开主张 AI 行业应当放慢脚步，并设想过让评估者拥有员工级权限、能够从内部检查安全机制与模型行为。其他前沿实验室也发布过关于第三方评估的指导文件，包括 OpenAI 针对前沿模型与防护措施独立评估所提出的原则。
threads.background_en: METR evaluates frontier AI models for capabilities that some researchers argue could pose catastrophic risks to society. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has publicly argued that the AI industry should slow down and has described evaluators with employee-level access who can inspect safety protocols and model behavior from the inside. Other frontier labs have also published guidance on third-party evaluations, including OpenAI's principles for independent assessments of frontier models and safeguards.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly defended the company's safety record and 'race to the top' strategy while acknowledging that AI may soon accelerate next-generation AI development enough to require direct limits on research speed, after critics questioned Anthropic's draft AI safety bill and relaxed internal safety commitments.
threads.latest_summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly defended the company's safety record and 'race to the top' strategy while acknowledging that AI may soon accelerate next-generation AI development enough to require direct limits on research speed, after critics questioned Anthropic's draft AI safety bill and relaxed internal safety commitments.
threads.market_impact_zh: 这条消息对加密市场没有直接的传导路径，但前沿实验室负责人关于放缓AI进展的表态会通过情绪面影响AI叙事类代币板块（去中心化算力、数据以及智能体代币）；而芯片出口或算力治理政策的收紧，又会反过来影响与矿工及AI数据中心运营方相关的硬件经济性。这些板块的价格重估很可能会先于基本面的可验证变化发生。
threads.market_impact_en: There is no direct crypto transmission here, but commentary from frontier-lab leaders on slowing AI progress feeds the AI-narrative token segment (decentralized compute, data and agent tokens) through sentiment, and any hardening of chip-export or compute-governance policy would in turn affect hardware economics that touch mining and AI-datacenter operators. Any repricing in those segments would likely run ahead of verifiable changes in fundamentals.

timeline.text_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly defended the company's safety record and 'race to the top' strategy while acknowledging that AI may soon accelerate next-generation AI development enough to require direct limits on research speed, after critics questioned Anthropic's draft AI safety bill and relaxed internal safety commitments.

timeline.text_zh: Anthropic 已向 METR 研究人员提供员工级内部系统访问权限，用于独立的风险与事件评估，并同意 METR 有权发布其评估结果，Anthropic 无权阻止。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic has granted METR researchers employee-level access to its internal systems for independent risk and incident evaluations, and agreed it cannot block METR from publishing its findings.

timeline.text_zh:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 于周六发布博客文章，认为AI发展速度过快，可能“超出我们理解和控制系统能力的速度”，并援引了递归自我改进以及7月OpenAI与Hugging Face的智能体事件作为依据。OpenAI CEO Sam Altman对此表示认同，称应放缓AI发展节奏，并表示OpenAI今年不会寻求IPO，以便专注于安全，Elon Musk也在X上发帖称“Dario说得对”。

两家领先前沿实验室的负责人以及一位最具影响力的AI投资者罕见地公开一致，认为有必要有意放缓前沿AI的发展步伐，这可能推动AI治理讨论转向协调一致的安全标准与独立评估。由于Amodei的提议针对前沿实验室、民主国家政府间的协调以及中国获取先进芯片的问题，因此牵涉的出口管制与监管议题远超任何一家公司的范畴。

Amodei 提出了三项提议：给予独立评估者类似实验室内部员工级别的访问权限；民主国家的前沿AI公司就共同安全标准以及限制不受约束的AI进展进行协调；民主国家政府尝试在认真对待合规核查难度的前提下，与威权政府进行协调。他还警告称，未来6到12个月内，像7月事件中那样的失控智能体集群可能具备接管整个互联网的能力，而Anthropic表示其已单方面承诺落实独立评估者这一项。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged a slowdown in AI development to a safer pace, citing recursive self-improvement risks and a recent OpenAI-Hugging Face agent incident, with OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk expressing agreement.

threads.title_zh: 摩根大通资产管理首次将比特币纳入长期资本市场假设，预测年化回报10%
threads.title_en: JPMorgan Sees Bitcoin Outperforming U.S. Stocks and Gold Over Next Decade
threads.summary_zh: 摩根资产管理最新发布的2027年长期资本市场假设显示，比特币在十三类资产中排名第一，预计未来10至15年年化回报率为10%，领先于REITs、小盘股、美国大盘股和黄金。
threads.summary_en: JPMorgan Asset Management's newly released 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions ranks Bitcoin first among thirteen asset classes with a projected 10% annualized return over 10-15 years, ahead of REITs, small caps, U.S. large caps and gold.

threads.latest_update_en: The same JPMorgan 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report added bull-case 16.6% and bear-case -11.2% annualized Bitcoin return scenarios, and explicitly said Bitcoin is not currently viewed as a portfolio diversifier but as a speculative asset and hedge against monetary easing.
threads.latest_summary_zh: JPMorgan Asset Management's long-term outlook projects Bitcoin will return 10% annualized over the next decade, outperforming US large-cap stocks and gold, while cautioning that volatility and unstable correlations limit its portfolio role.
threads.latest_summary_en: JPMorgan Asset Management's long-term outlook projects Bitcoin will return 10% annualized over the next decade, outperforming US large-cap stocks and gold, while cautioning that volatility and unstable correlations limit its portfolio role.

threads.title_zh: Strive扩大并完成6.3亿美元SATS优先股IPO
threads.title_en: Strive upsizes and closes $630M SATS preferred stock IPO
threads.summary_zh: Strive 完成 6.3 亿美元 SATS 优先股 IPO，但未说明将把多少募资用于购买比特币。
threads.summary_en: Strive closed a $630M SATS preferred stock IPO but did not specify how much of the proceeds it will allocate to Bitcoin purchases.
threads.latest_update_zh: Strive 完成 6.3 亿美元 SATS 优先股 IPO，但未说明将把多少募资用于购买比特币。
threads.latest_update_en: Strive closed a $630M SATS preferred stock IPO but did not specify how much of the proceeds it will allocate to Bitcoin purchases.
threads.background_zh: Strive是一家上市资产管理公司，2025年转型为比特币财库公司，通过并购在纳斯达克上市并在资产负债表上持续积累比特币，其宣称目标是提高每股对应的比特币数量并长期跑赢比特币。优先股不同于普通股，支付固定股息且清偿顺序优先于普通股股东，而累积性条款要求未付股息结转至后续期间。
threads.background_en: Strive is a publicly traded asset management firm that repositioned itself as a Bitcoin treasury company in 2025, going public on Nasdaq through a merger and accumulating Bitcoin on its balance sheet; its stated aim is to increase Bitcoin per share and outperform Bitcoin over the long run. Preferred stock, unlike common equity, pays a fixed dividend with priority over common shareholders, and cumulative terms require unpaid amounts to be carried forward.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Strive closed a $630M SATS preferred stock IPO but did not specify how much of the proceeds it will allocate to Bitcoin purchases.
threads.latest_summary_en: Strive closed a $630M SATS preferred stock IPO but did not specify how much of the proceeds it will allocate to Bitcoin purchases.
threads.market_impact_zh: 该交易建立了一条公开市场通道，使追逐收益的股票资金有望转化为单一发行方的现货比特币买盘，其规模取决于约6.08亿美元净募资中最终有多少配置到BTC。同时它增加了一款按日付息、年息15%的收益型工具，与其它收益类资产争夺资金，并使Strive的股息支付义务成为对其财库资产的持续性索取权。
threads.market_impact_en: The deal creates a public-market channel through which equity income demand can convert into potential spot Bitcoin buying by a single issuer, with the size of that demand depending on how much of the roughly $608 million in net proceeds is ultimately allocated to BTC. It also adds a daily-paid 15% yield instrument that competes for income-oriented capital and makes Strive's dividend obligation a recurring claim on its treasury.

timeline.text_zh: Vitalik Buterin 表示，EIP-8288 将允许用户通过 STARK 和聚合器证明任意签名方案，从而可能使以太坊永远无需新增签名预编译合约。
timeline.text_en: Vitalik Buterin said EIP-8288 would let users prove arbitrary signature schemes with STARKs and an aggregator, potentially sparing Ethereum from ever adding new signature precompiles.

threads.title_zh: Mistral发布Voxtral 3：把语音识别、推理和工具调用接成实时Agent
threads.title_en: Voxtral 3
threads.summary_zh: Mistral 发布了 Voxtral 3，这是一个模块化语音栈，包含转录模型、语音合成模型和基于 LiveKit 的 Voice Agent SDK，支持 50 多种语言的转录与实时语音 Agent；该模型仍为闭源。
threads.summary_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a modular speech stack with transcription models, a synthesis model, and a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK, supporting 50+ languages for transcription and real-time voice agents; the model remains closed-source.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增披露 Voxtral 3 为模块化语音栈，包含三款转录模型、一款语音合成模型和基于 LiveKit 的 Voice Agent SDK；转录支持 50 多种语言，语音合成支持 35 种以上语言和 50 多种方言，并公布 API 定价。
threads.latest_update_en: Added details that Voxtral 3 is a modular speech stack with three transcription models, a synthesis model, and a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK; transcription supports 50+ languages, synthesis supports 35+ languages and 50+ dialects, with API pricing disclosed.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a modular speech-to-speech stack with transcription and synthesis models plus a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK for real-time tool-calling agents.
threads.latest_summary_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, a modular speech-to-speech stack with transcription and synthesis models plus a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK for real-time tool-calling agents.

timeline.text_zh: 新增披露 Voxtral 3 为模块化语音栈，包含三款转录模型、一款语音合成模型和基于 LiveKit 的 Voice Agent SDK；转录支持 50 多种语言，语音合成支持 35 种以上语言和 50 多种方言，并公布 API 定价。
timeline.text_en: Added details that Voxtral 3 is a modular speech stack with three transcription models, a synthesis model, and a LiveKit-based Voice Agent SDK; transcription supports 50+ languages, synthesis supports 35+ languages and 50+ dialects, with API pricing disclosed.

timeline.text_zh: Mistral 发布 Voxtral 3，这是一款升级版语音模型，提供转写、说话人分离和语音生成能力，但仍为闭源。
timeline.text_en: Mistral released Voxtral 3, an upgraded speech model offering transcription, diarization, and speech-generation capabilities, though it remains closed-source.

threads.title_zh: 万事达卡开放AI代理支付，提供早期访问和现场演示
threads.title_en: Mastercard Opens Up AI Agent Payments With Early Access and Live Demo
threads.summary_zh: Mastercard 已开放 Agent Pay for Machines 早期接入，AI 代理可通过 x402 支付凭证在人类设定预算内发现并支付服务，由 Coinbase 钱包、Base 链上结算及 BVNK 法币/稳定币通道支持；并已进行 live demo、提供开发者 API/SDK/沙盒，且与 Cloudflare、AWS、Coinbase 等开展试点。
threads.summary_en: Mastercard has opened early access to Agent Pay for Machines, letting AI agents discover and pay for services within human-set budgets via x402 payment vouchers settled through Coinbase wallets, Base on-chain settlement and BVNK fiat/stablecoin rails; it has also run a live demo, offered developer APIs/SDKs/sandbox, and begun pilots with Cloudflare, AWS and Coinbase.
threads.latest_update_zh: 新增事实：Mastercard 在 Cloudflare Connect 大会上演示了 Agent Pay for Machines 的实际交易，一个营销代理在单一预算下向两家独立商户完成 9 笔支付；同时宣布向开发者提供买卖方 API、SDK 和沙盒，并已与 Cloudflare、AWS、Coinbase 等开展端到端试点。
threads.latest_update_en: New facts: Mastercard demonstrated live Agent Pay for Machines transactions at Cloudflare Connect, with a marketing agent completing 9 payments to two independent merchants under one budget; it also announced buyer/seller APIs, SDKs and a sandbox for developers, and end-to-end pilots with Cloudflare, AWS and Coinbase.
threads.latest_summary_zh: Mastercard opened early access to its Agent Pay for Machines system, letting AI agents autonomously discover services, negotiate and pay under human-set budgets via the x402 protocol with Coinbase wallets, Base on-chain settlement and BVNK fiat/stablecoin rails, alongside developer APIs, SDKs and a sandbox.
threads.latest_summary_en: Mastercard opened early access to its Agent Pay for Machines system, letting AI agents autonomously discover services, negotiate and pay under human-set budgets via the x402 protocol with Coinbase wallets, Base on-chain settlement and BVNK fiat/stablecoin rails, alongside developer APIs, SDKs and a sandbox.

timeline.text_zh: 新增事实：Mastercard 在 Cloudflare Connect 大会上演示了 Agent Pay for Machines 的实际交易，一个营销代理在单一预算下向两家独立商户完成 9 笔支付；同时宣布向开发者提供买卖方 API、SDK 和沙盒，并已与 Cloudflare、AWS、Coinbase 等开展端到端试点。
timeline.text_en: New facts: Mastercard demonstrated live Agent Pay for Machines transactions at Cloudflare Connect, with a marketing agent completing 9 payments to two independent merchants under one budget; it also announced buyer/seller APIs, SDKs and a sandbox for developers, and end-to-end pilots with Cloudflare, AWS and Coinbase.

timeline.text_zh: 万事达卡开放了Agent Pay for Machines的早期访问，允许AI代理在人类设定的限额内发现并支付服务，通过x402支付凭证经Coinbase、Base和BVNK以法币或稳定币结算。
timeline.text_en: Mastercard opened early access to Agent Pay for Machines, letting AI agents discover and pay for services within human-set limits via x402 payment vouchers settled through Coinbase, Base, and BVNK in fiat or stablecoins.

focus.title_zh: Anthropic提交S-1申请纳斯达克IPO，招股书披露能源依赖与融资安排
focus.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO
focus.summary_zh: Anthropic 已提交纳斯达克 IPO 的 S-1；最新报道基于同一份招股书脚注推算出董事会 2026 年 9 月 30 日每股公允价值约 71.43 美元，对应约 1.2 万亿美元估值，并补充了历轮股价和近期私有市场报价。
focus.summary_en: Anthropic has filed its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO; the latest report infers from a footnote in the same prospectus that the board's Sept. 30, 2026 fair value was about $71.43 per share, implying a roughly $1.2T valuation, and adds historical round prices and recent private-market quotes.
focus.latest_update_zh: 同一份 S-1 的脚注计算显示，Anthropic 董事会将 2026 年 9 月 30 日的每股公允价值定为约 71.43 美元：公司以约 2800 万股无投票权 Class N 股份结算 20 亿美元慈善捐赠匹配义务；按约 169 亿股计算隐含估值约 1.2 万亿美元。报道还梳理了从 Series E 到 Series H 的股价历程及 10 月市场报价。
focus.latest_update_en: A footnote calculation in the same S-1 indicates Anthropic's board marked fair value at about $71.43 per share as of Sept. 30, 2026: the company settled a $2B charitable donation-match obligation with roughly 28M non-voting Class N shares, implying a valuation of about $1.2T on ~16.9B shares. The report also traces share-price history from Series E through Series H and October market quotes.
focus.background_zh: SEC 的 S-1 表格是注册声明，在上市时成为公司业务、财务和风险状况的权威公开记录。此前人们预期 AI 数据中心将由太阳能和风电场供电，但如今已转为争相建设天然气发电，这带来了显著的气候后果。
focus.background_en: An SEC Form S-1 is the registration statement that becomes the definitive public record of a company's business, finances and risk profile at the time of listing. Early expectations that AI data centers would draw power from solar and wind farms have given way to a rush to build natural gas generation, which carries significant climate consequences.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Anthropic's IPO prospectus left its share price blank, but a footnote calculation based on a $2 billion charitable share obligation settled with roughly 28 million Class N shares implies a price of about $71.43 per share.
focus.latest_summary_en: Anthropic's IPO prospectus left its share price blank, but a footnote calculation based on a $2 billion charitable share obligation settled with roughly 28 million Class N shares implies a price of about $71.43 per share.
focus.market_impact_zh: 这一披露把 AI 算力扩张与电力可获得性和燃气发电绑定在一起，成本传导路径涉及数据中心运营商、表后供电供应商，以及争夺同一批电网接入和带电选址的其他大型用电方。随着 AI 基础设施交易走向成熟，与气候相关的披露也被推到公开股票投资者面前。
focus.market_impact_en: The disclosure ties AI compute expansion to power availability and gas-fired generation, a cost channel that runs through data center operators, behind-the-meter power suppliers and other large electricity buyers competing for the same grid interconnects and powered sites. It also puts climate-related disclosure in front of public-equity investors as the AI infrastructure trade matures.

timeline.text_zh: 同一份 S-1 的脚注计算显示，Anthropic 董事会将 2026 年 9 月 30 日的每股公允价值定为约 71.43 美元：公司以约 2800 万股无投票权 Class N 股份结算 20 亿美元慈善捐赠匹配义务；按约 169 亿股计算隐含估值约 1.2 万亿美元。报道还梳理了从 Series E 到 Series H 的股价历程及 10 月市场报价。
timeline.text_en: A footnote calculation in the same S-1 indicates Anthropic's board marked fair value at about $71.43 per share as of Sept. 30, 2026: the company settled a $2B charitable donation-match obligation with roughly 28M non-voting Class N shares, implying a valuation of about $1.2T on ~16.9B shares. The report also traces share-price history from Series E through Series H and October market quotes.

timeline.text_zh: 同一份 IPO 招股书进一步披露：2023 年至 2026 年上半年累计筹资约 1400 亿美元，其中 2026 年上半年筹资 1100 亿美元（含 652 亿美元 H 轮）；截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日现金及短期投资约 1320 亿美元，另有 25 亿美元受限现金、150 亿美元未提取循环信贷和最高 770 亿美元合作伙伴票据融资；总算力承诺约 7800 亿至 8100 亿美元，其中自 2026 年 12 月起每年向 SpaceXAI 承诺约 370 亿美元算力。
timeline.text_en: The same IPO prospectus further discloses about $140B raised from 2023 through H1 2026, including $110B in H1 2026 (with a $65.2B Series H); about $132B in cash and short-term investments as of June 30, 2026, plus $2.5B restricted cash, a $15B undrawn revolving credit facility, and up to $77B in partner note financing; total compute commitments of roughly $780B–$810B, including about $37B a year to SpaceXAI starting December 2026.

timeline.text_zh:
Anthropic 周一向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交的公开 S-1 文件披露，其数据中心建设正日益依赖天然气，并写明“获取电力供应和电力充足的数据中心选址的竞争非常激烈”。该文件同时披露了在纳斯达克上市、股票代码为 ANT 的计划。

这份文件使 AI 的能源供应与气候暴露在头部实验室上市前成为公开市场投资者面前一项明确的风险因素，而不再是外部批评者提出的背景性议题。

被引述的表述属于风险披露，而非已确定的采购计划。对同一份文件的报道还指出，Anthropic 约五分之一的收入来自两家客户。
timeline.text_en: Anthropic's S-1 filing ahead of its IPO discloses that data center expansion is increasingly dependent on natural gas and constrained by intense competition for electricity supply and powered sites, surfacing AI's energy and climate risk to public-market investors.

focus.title_zh: Meta盘前转涨1.12%，英伟达、AMD和博通有意购买至多50亿美元Meta股票
focus.title_en: Meta盘前转涨1.12%，英伟达、AMD和博通有意购买至多50亿美元Meta股票
focus.summary_zh: Meta的股权融资计划已上调至975亿美元，含超额配售最高约1030亿美元，由250亿美元普通股、约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划构成，用于支持AI投资；此前英伟达30亿美元投资及双方AI合作仍在推进。
focus.summary_en: Meta's equity financing plan has been upsized to $97.5B, or up to about $103B including the greenshoe, comprising $25B of common stock, about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program to fund AI investments; Nvidia's previously announced $3B investment and expanded AI collaboration remain in place.
focus.latest_update_zh: Meta将股票融资计划规模从约950亿美元小幅上调至975亿美元，最高含超额配售可达约1030亿美元；普通股发行规模从225亿美元提高至250亿美元，并保留约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划。
focus.latest_update_en: Meta raised its planned stock offering from about $95B to $97.5B, or up to roughly $103B including the greenshoe; it increased the common stock tranche from $22.5B to $25B while retaining about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and an at-the-market program of up to $60B.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Meta raised its planned stock offering to $97.5B — up to roughly $103B with the greenshoe — to finance artificial intelligence investments, increasing the common stock tranche to $25B alongside ~$12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program.
focus.latest_summary_en: Meta raised its planned stock offering to $97.5B — up to roughly $103B with the greenshoe — to finance artificial intelligence investments, increasing the common stock tranche to $25B alongside ~$12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program.

timeline.text_zh: Meta将股票融资计划规模从约950亿美元小幅上调至975亿美元，最高含超额配售可达约1030亿美元；普通股发行规模从225亿美元提高至250亿美元，并保留约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划。
timeline.text_en: Meta raised its planned stock offering from about $95B to $97.5B, or up to roughly $103B including the greenshoe; it increased the common stock tranche from $22.5B to $25B while retaining about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and an at-the-market program of up to $60B.

timeline.text_zh: 英伟达将向Meta股权发行投资30亿美元，双方并扩大AI基础设施与模型合作。
timeline.text_en: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity issuance, with the two companies expanding their AI infrastructure and model partnership.

timeline.text_zh: Meta 启动约 350 亿美元的双承销股权发行——其中约 225 亿美元的 A 类普通股通过远期销售协议发行，约 125 亿美元的 A 系列强制可转换优先存托股份——据报道英伟达、AMD 和博通有意各自购买最多 50 亿美元的 Meta 股票，推动 META 盘前上涨 1.12%。
timeline.text_en: Meta launched a roughly $35B dual underwritten equity offering — about $22.5B of Class A common stock via forward sale agreements and about $12.5B of Series A mandatory convertible preferred depositary shares — with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom reportedly interested in purchasing up to $5B of Meta stock each, lifting META 1.12% in premarket trading.

focus.title_zh: GLM-5.3 Workers AI 模型中的跨请求 KV 缓存暴露（155 条响应）
focus.title_en: Cross-request KV cache exposure in the GLM-5.3 Workers AI model (155 responses)
focus.summary_zh: Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 的用户隔离泄露已修复，SGLang 相关缓存管理缺陷已修补并建议升级至 v0.5.22；未发现恶意利用，其他 Workers AI 模型未受影响。
focus.summary_en: The Cloudflare Workers AI GLM-5.3 user-isolation leak has been fixed; related SGLang cache-management defects were patched with a recommendation to upgrade to v0.5.22; no malicious exploitation was found and other Workers AI models were unaffected.
focus.latest_update_zh: 披露了另一类 SGLang 缓存重用漏洞、其修复版本 v0.5.22，以及实际泄露已于 9 月 9 日修复、未发现恶意利用且其他 Workers AI 模型未受影响。
focus.latest_update_en: Disclosed a separate SGLang cache-reuse bug, its fix version v0.5.22, and that the actual leak was fixed on September 9, with no evidence of malicious exploitation and other Workers AI models unaffected.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Cloudflare disclosed that a GPU cache capacity mismatch in its Workers AI GLM-5.3 deployment let 155 over-length requests leak other customers' cached content, alongside a related SGLang cache-reuse bug that the SGLang team has since patched.
focus.latest_summary_en: Cloudflare disclosed that a GPU cache capacity mismatch in its Workers AI GLM-5.3 deployment let 155 over-length requests leak other customers' cached content, alongside a related SGLang cache-reuse bug that the SGLang team has since patched.

timeline.text_zh: 披露了另一类 SGLang 缓存重用漏洞、其修复版本 v0.5.22，以及实际泄露已于 9 月 9 日修复、未发现恶意利用且其他 Workers AI 模型未受影响。
timeline.text_en: Disclosed a separate SGLang cache-reuse bug, its fix version v0.5.22, and that the actual leak was fixed on September 9, with no evidence of malicious exploitation and other Workers AI models unaffected.

timeline.text_zh: Cloudflare 发布了对 Workers AI 一个缺陷的根因分析：GLM-5.3 的跨请求 KV 缓存未在用户之间正确隔离，可能导致会话内存重叠，问题追溯至预填充缓存容量不匹配，已通过将该模型下线修复。
timeline.text_en: Cloudflare published a root-cause analysis of a Workers AI bug in which GLM-5.3's cross-request KV cache was not properly isolated between users, allowing potential overlap of session memory, traced to a prefill cache capacity mismatch and remediated by pulling the model from serving.

focus.title_zh: Keystone 称网站遭入侵，暴露硬件钱包买家的地址
focus.title_en: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
focus.summary_zh: Keystone 正在处置 10 月 20 日官网入侵事件：认证密钥被窃，旧密钥设备认证失效，库存 18,835 台设备将销毁，官网发货暂停至新密钥设备投产；已确认 25,964 条买家记录及 12,873 条结账记录泄露，并请求 Shopify 删除相关数据；10 月 20 日前交付设备仍视为安全，此后交付设备需额外验证。
focus.summary_en: Keystone is remediating the October 20 website breach: the authentication key was stolen, old-key device authentication is invalid, 18,835 inventory devices are to be destroyed, and website shipments are paused until new-key devices are produced; it confirmed 25,964 buyer records and 12,873 checkout records were leaked and has requested Shopify delete related data; devices delivered before October 20 are considered safe, while devices delivered afterward require additional verification.
focus.latest_update_zh: Keystone 进一步披露：攻击者利用第三方监控工具漏洞提权，除客户信息外还窃取了设备认证密钥，可能让伪造钱包通过真伪校验；泄露的买家记录为 25,964 条，另有 12,873 条未完成结账记录被 Shopify 保留并遭窃取；10 月 20 日前已生产交付的设备仍视为安全，此后交付的设备真伪无法保证。
focus.latest_update_en: Keystone further disclosed that the attacker escalated privileges via a third-party monitoring tool vulnerability and stole a device-authentication key that could let counterfeit wallets pass authenticity checks; 25,964 buyer records were stolen, along with 12,873 incomplete checkout records retained by Shopify; devices manufactured and delivered before the October 20 incident are considered safe, while authenticity of devices delivered after that date cannot be guaranteed.
focus.latest_summary_zh: Keystone disclosed that attackers who breached its website also stole an authentication key that could allow counterfeit hardware wallets to pass genuineness checks, widening a customer-data leak into a device-supply-chain risk.
focus.latest_summary_en: Keystone disclosed that attackers who breached its website also stole an authentication key that could allow counterfeit hardware wallets to pass genuineness checks, widening a customer-data leak into a device-supply-chain risk.

timeline.text_zh: Keystone 进一步披露：攻击者利用第三方监控工具漏洞提权，除客户信息外还窃取了设备认证密钥，可能让伪造钱包通过真伪校验；泄露的买家记录为 25,964 条，另有 12,873 条未完成结账记录被 Shopify 保留并遭窃取；10 月 20 日前已生产交付的设备仍视为安全，此后交付的设备真伪无法保证。
timeline.text_en: Keystone further disclosed that the attacker escalated privileges via a third-party monitoring tool vulnerability and stole a device-authentication key that could let counterfeit wallets pass authenticity checks; 25,964 buyer records were stolen, along with 12,873 incomplete checkout records retained by Shopify; devices manufactured and delivered before the October 20 incident are considered safe, while authenticity of devices delivered after that date cannot be guaranteed.

timeline.text_zh: Keystone 确认泄露范围包括用于验证设备真伪的认证密钥，将停用旧密钥、销毁库存中 18,835 台使用旧密钥的设备、暂停官网未发货订单配送直至新密钥设备投产，并将客户信息保留期由 180 天缩短至 90 天。
timeline.text_en: Keystone confirmed the leaked data included device-authentication keys, and said it will retire the old keys, destroy 18,835 inventory devices built with them, pause shipment of unfulfilled website orders until new-key devices are produced, and cut customer data retention from 180 to 90 days.

timeline.text_zh: Keystone 披露了一起网站入侵事件，未经授权的第三方访问了客户收货信息，引发了对定向钓鱼和人身攻击的警告。
timeline.text_en: Keystone disclosed a website breach in which an unauthorized third party accessed customer shipping information, prompting warnings about targeted phishing and physical attacks.

focus.title_zh: 汇丰公布香港稳定币名称「HSBC RedCoin」并计划分阶段推出
focus.title_en: HSBC Names Hong Kong Stablecoin 'RedCoin' and Plans Phased Rollout
focus.summary_zh: 汇丰RedCoin已在PayMe向超过330万用户分阶段推出，支持P2P转账及逾10万家商户支付；代码RCHKD，运行于汇丰私有账本，初期约1020万美元流通并由1040万美元现金支撑，暂不受存款保障覆盖；计划年底前扩展至汇丰手机银行及代币化货币市场基金认购，首次独立储备认证预计在2026年第四季度之后。
focus.summary_en: HSBC's RedCoin is in phased rollout to more than 3.3 million PayMe users, supporting P2P transfers and payments at over 100,000 merchants; ticker RCHKD, running on HSBC's private ledger, with about $10.2 million circulating backed by $10.4 million in cash and no deposit protection coverage; HSBC plans to expand to its HK Mobile Banking app and tokenized money market fund subscriptions by year-end, with first independent reserve attestation expected after Q4 2026.
focus.latest_update_zh: 新报道补充：RedCoin代码为RCHKD，PayMe首阶段覆盖逾10万家商户；发行初期约1020万美元RedCoin流通，由1040万美元现金全额支撑；代币运行于汇丰私有账本，PayMe与汇丰银行App间余额暂不能互转，且不受香港存款保障计划覆盖；首次独立储备认证预计在2026年第四季度之后。
focus.latest_update_en: The new report adds that RedCoin's ticker is RCHKD, the initial PayMe phase covers more than 100,000 merchants, roughly $10.2 million of RedCoin was circulating shortly after launch backed by $10.4 million in cash, the token runs on HSBC's private ledger, balances cannot yet move between PayMe and HSBC's banking app, it is not covered by Hong Kong's Deposit Protection Scheme, and the first independent reserve attestation is expected after Q4 2026.
focus.background_zh: 汇丰于今年4月获得香港金管局（该市事实上的中央银行）颁发的稳定币发行人牌照，相关监管制度于2025年8月生效；截至当年9月，汇丰在至少36家竞争申请者中率先获批。汇丰于2026年9月30日正式公布RedCoin这一名称。其他银行也在争夺同一支付场景：去年9月，包括高盛和美国银行在内的21家贷款机构宣布计划联合推出美元稳定币，目标在2027年上半年上线。
focus.background_en: HSBC obtained its stablecoin issuer licence from the HKMA — the city's de facto central bank — in April, under a regime that took effect in August 2025, beating a field of at least 36 competing applicants by September of that year. HSBC unveiled the RedCoin name on 30 September 2026. Other banks are pursuing the same payments ground: in September, 21 lenders including Goldman Sachs and Bank of America announced plans for a joint dollar stablecoin targeting a launch in the first half of 2027.
focus.latest_summary_zh: HSBC launched RedCoin, an HKMA-licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, on its PayMe app, enabling 3.3 million-plus users to hold, transfer, and spend the token at over 100,000 merchants, with expansion into the HK Mobile Banking app and institutional use cases planned.
focus.latest_summary_en: HSBC launched RedCoin, an HKMA-licensed Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, on its PayMe app, enabling 3.3 million-plus users to hold, transfer, and spend the token at over 100,000 merchants, with expansion into the HK Mobile Banking app and institutional use cases planned.
focus.market_impact_zh: 此次落地将稳定币的分发渠道转向拥有存量用户的银行消费钱包，这一渠道可能在支付领域对非银行的港元稳定币发行方形成压力；但私有账本设计及闭环式的可转移性限制了其与公链场所的互操作性。由于流通量仅约1020万美元，对加密交易市场的即时流动性影响微不足道。
focus.market_impact_en: The rollout shifts stablecoin distribution toward a bank-operated consumer wallet with a captive user base, a channel that could pressure non-bank HKD-denominated issuers on the payments side, though the private-ledger design and closed-loop transferability limit interoperability with public-chain venues. With circulating supply near $10.2 million, the immediate liquidity effect on crypto trading markets is negligible.
